Prism 1.30.0
============

Vendored from https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v1.30.0 under the MIT license (see LICENSE).

prism.js includes the default markup, CSS, C-like and JavaScript grammars.
Additional components: markup-templating, PHP, SQL, JSON, Bash and Apache configuration.
Load markup-templating before PHP. Highlighting is explicitly invoked by app.js.
No runtime CDN requests are needed.
